# Test default config values
exec axen config get check_for_updates
stdout 'true'

exec axen config get default_update_policy
stdout 'daily'

# Test setting valid config values
exec axen config set check_for_updates false
exec axen config get check_for_updates
stdout 'false'

exec axen config set default_update_policy weekly
exec axen config get default_update_policy
stdout 'weekly'

# Verify JSON format on disk
exists $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.axen/config.json
grep '"check_for_updates": false' $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.axen/config.json
grep '"default_update_policy": "weekly"' $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.axen/config.json

# Test invalid update policy rejection
! exec axen config set default_update_policy invalid_policy
stdout 'invalid update policy'

# Test unknown config key
! exec axen config get unknown_key
stdout 'unknown key'
